summary: SiteProfileHistory class provides a structure for recording historical changes in site profiles.
purpose: To track and store changes made to site profiles, capturing details of actions and entities involved.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the site profile history entry.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: Date when the action took place.

fields.name: ScreenSection
fields.description: Section of the screen where the action occurred.

fields.name: Fields
fields.description: Fields that were affected by the action.

fields.name: LastName
fields.description: Last name of the user involved.

fields.name: FirstName
fields.description: First name of the user involved.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Middle name of the user involved.

fields.name: Phone
fields.description: Phone details of the user involved.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: User ID of the individual making the change.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Flag indicating if the user is a system administrator.
